Actual gameplay · Developed farm

Build your tropical farm

Grow vegetables and care for animals in a 3D farm surrounded by rice fields. Sell your produce at the market to build and upgrade your Indonesian farmhouse.

Free · No accountPlay in 3D

English and Indonesian · Requires WebGL 2

  • 10 farmhouse models

    Upgrade from a timber cottage to a tropical estate. Each house comes with a satellite dish.

  • Meal delivery to the market

    Order a meal from home. Watch the scooter courier take turns with the produce truck on the village road.

  • A farm that changes with the time

    Workers tend the fields, barns, and fish pond by day. Street lamps come on at night.
